task_name: DAgger Semantics and Residual Structure Analysis

D1_formula_restoration.summary: Round 0: (F_real(s,u) - GP(s,u))/std (Version L at expert states). Round 1+: (s_real[k+1] - GP(GP(s_base[k],tau),tau))/std (two-step GP trajectory comparison).

code_references.audit_wrong: DAGGER_SEMANTICS_AUDIT.md claims 'pure local dynamics' but code shows two-step GP

D2_two_versions.summary: Version L (local dynamics residual) and Version T (trajectory synchronization residual) implemented as standalone classes.

D3_fair_comparison.summary: Same data (2000 samples), same NN (ResidualNet 3 models), same seeds (42), same training (50 epochs, 2 rounds). Evaluated on Mode A/B/C/D, per-state, initial conditions, action signals, OOD.

key_findings.initial_conditions: T is more robust (0.52 vs 1.80 for large_phi)
key_findings.per_state: T better on delta (0.20 vs 0.51) and delta_dot (0.46 vs 1.22)
key_findings.ood: L better on single-step OOD (0.004 vs 0.041)

D4_naming_decision.summary: Original code is NOT standard DAgger, NOT clean Version L, NOT clean Version T. It is an inconsistent residual ensemble. Recommended names: L-Dagger (Version L) and T-Dagger (Version T).
D4_naming_decision.recommendation: Use 'Residual Dynamics Ensemble' (RDE) as umbrella; qualify with -L or -T suffix

CONFIRMED: Round 1+ formula is two-step GP trajectory comparison
Version L is better for Mode A and Mode D
Version T is better for Mode B and initial condition robustness
Original code has inconsistent training objectives across rounds
INFERRED: Two-step GP in original was likely a coding error (not intentional design)
residual_scale=0.3 limits trajectory divergence within one DAgger round
NN structure (128-hidden) is adequate for both versions
UNKNOWN: Whether larger n_models would change the winner
Whether more DAgger rounds would close the gap

risk_notes: GP training takes ~4 min with 2000 samples (scalability concern)
Results may vary with different random seeds (only seed=42 tested)
Mode B and C are identical in this evaluation (both use model trajectory)
OOD test is single-step only; multi-step OOD not tested
